title: Two habitat patches
hook: A path can connect places that were separated.

knows: Animals depend on features of their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In this toy map, animals cannot cross the surrounding barrier. What does adding a habitat corridor between the two patches allow in the model?

misconception: A single observation or change determines the same outcome everywhere.
objective: In this toy map, animals cannot cross the surrounding barrier. What does adding a habitat corridor between the two patches allow in the model?

claims.text: In this toy map, animals cannot cross the surrounding barrier. What does adding a habitat corridor between the two patches allow in the model? The first panel shows two patches separated by a stipulated barrier; the second adds a connecting strip. In this toy map, the strip creates a possible route between patches. Real use and effectiveness depend on the species, corridor design and surrounding landscape.
claims.source: Stipulated illustrative scenario, not wildlife observations. Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The panels show a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
Two habitats have no other traversable connection in a toy map. What does a usable link between them add? A usable corridor adds a possible route but not guaranteed movement.
